_meta.description: Deferred internal links. Every link that was planned in the interlinking map but points to a page NOT yet live. When a new page is published, search this file for its page_id as target_page_id and update all listed source pages to add the link.
_meta.instructions: HOW TO USE: (1) When publishing a new page, search this file for its page_id under target_page_id. (2) For every match found, go to the source page (source_page_id) and inject the link at the specified placement. (3) Move resolved entries to the resolved_links section below. (4) Add new pending entries here whenever you write a link in content that points to a future page.

pending_links.source_page_id: [page_id of the page that ALREADY CONTAINS the placeholder text]
pending_links.target_page_id: [page_id of the page that does NOT exist yet]
pending_links.anchor_text: [the exact anchor text written in the source page content]
pending_links.placement: [e.g. Services section card | Body paragraph 3 | CTA section]
pending_links.notes: Plain text written in source page. Re-activate as hyperlink when target page goes live.

resolved_links._note: Move entries here after activating the link on the source page.
